dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave curvature forming a falcate profile, tapering sharply towards the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute, narrow-radius tip with jagged irregularities along the distal-posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin rising at approximately a 45-50 degree angle relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Vertical height from the dorsal ridge to the apex is roughly equal (1:1 ratio) to the horizontal base width.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Moderate convex curvature of the melon with a smooth, continuous slope transitioning into the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust visible beak with a high thickness-to-length ratio extending from the cranial base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse interior angle at the transition point where the melon slope meets the rostrum shelf.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable V-shaped notch on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin near the apex; circular pale-colored mark or lesion on the lateral surface of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast bicolor pigmentation featuring a dark dorsal cape and a stark white ventral region; distinct dark coloration surrounding the ocular region.
